orchestrator.description: Primary daily-driver. Plans the day's small increment, delegates to subagents, runs the git flow, and updates Notion. Use this for the one-shot daily prompt.

planner.description: Read-only planning agent. Breaks the roadmap into the next small, shippable increment without writing code. Invoke before building when scope is unclear.

core-engineer.description: C/C++ specialist for the daemon, control plane, inference runtime, wire codec, and SIMD kernels. Owns CMake. Never writes Python or frontend code.

ai-engineer.description: Python specialist for model quantization/conversion, the adaptive scheduler, and the policy compiler. Never touches the C/C++ hot path or the frontend.

frontend-engineer.description: TypeScript/React specialist for the dashboard, topology graph, and live event stream. Frontend only; no backend logic.

reviewer.description: Read-only code reviewer. Checks the language-pool discipline, SemVer correctness, scope creep against the roadmap, and that the increment is genuinely small. Makes no changes.

scribe.description: Updates Notion (sprint board, tasks, tags), writes the CHANGELOG entry, and crafts conventional-commit messages and the PR body. Uses the notion MCP. No source-code edits.
